cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

mechanism: Copy a new manager's desk-clearing without recognizing the promotion move, then use the revealed office benefit as increasingly bitter congratulation.
confusable: Not generic envy: B2 must show the copied action had a different reason, and A3 must turn that knowledge into praise rather than confess confusion.
comparison: Coworkers negotiate remaining desk space rather than a ceremonial photo.
seedUse: Retains promotion and resentment about easy advancement; new copied desk packing makes the actual benefit concrete.
